info.name: X-Fighter API
info.description: MMA Fighter Management System - REST API Documentation

request.description: Authenticate user with email and password. Returns JWT access token and refresh token.
Register a new fighter with required documents (ID Card, Medical Certificate, Federal License). Account will be in PENDING status awaiting verification.
Register a new referee with required documents (ID Card, License). Account will be in PENDING status awaiting verification.
Register a new coach with required documents (ID Card, License). Account will be in PENDING status awaiting verification.
Obtain a new access token using a valid refresh token
Logout user and invalidate the refresh token
Retrieve the currently authenticated user's profile information
Retrieve the authenticated club's own profile information

Retrieve a specific club's profile by its ID
Retrieve the public profile of a club including coaches and basic information
Retrieve all fighters belonging to the specified club

request.description: Create a new club. Only ADMIN or ORGANIZER can perform this action.
Send an invitation to a fighter to join the authenticated club
Send an invitation to a coach to join the authenticated club
Accept or reject a fighter's request to join the club. Action must be 'ACCEPT' or 'REJECT'.
Accept or reject a coach's request to join the club. Action must be 'ACCEPT' or 'REJECT'.
Update the club's logo URL. Club can update its own logo, or ADMIN/ORGANIZER can update any club's logo.
Block an active club. Only ADMIN, ORGANIZER, or SUPER_ADMIN can perform this action.
Activate a pending or blocked club. Only ADMIN, ORGANIZER, or SUPER_ADMIN can perform this action.
Verify a fighter belonging to the authenticated club. Only the club that owns the fighter can verify them.
List tournaments with pagination

request.description: Create a new tournament
Get tournament by ID
Update tournament details
Delete a tournament
Adds an actual competition division to a tournament.
List tournament divisions
Registers a fighter into a tournament division. CLUB can register only fighters belonging to that gym, COACH only fighters assigned to that coach, FIGHTER only himself.
List all tournament registrations
Approve a tournament registration
Reject a tournament registration with a reason
Cancel a tournament registration
Add a rule to the tournament
List all rules for a tournament
Open registrations for the tournament
Close registrations for the tournament
Reopens registrations after they were closed. A reason is required.
Starts the tournament. Status becomes IN_PROGRESS.
Mark tournament as completed
Get audit log of all lifecycle changes (open, close, start, etc.)
List all organizers with pagination. SUPER_ADMIN sees all. ADMIN sees only their country's organizers.
Create a new organizer with ACTIVE status. Only SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN can create organizers. ADMIN can only create in their own country.
Retrieve organizer details. SUPER_ADMIN can view any organizer. ADMIN can only view organizers they created.
Update organizer details. SUPER_ADMIN can update any organizer. ADMIN can only update organizers in their own country.
Block an organizer (set status to DISABLED). Cannot block yourself.
Unblock an organizer (set status to ACTIVE).
Retrieve the authenticated organizer's profile information. Only for ORGANIZER role.
Update the authenticated organizer's profile information.
Change password for the authenticated organizer. Must provide current password.
SUPER_ADMIN gets paginated list of all admins with optional filters.
SUPER_ADMIN creates a new admin user. Status is automatically set to ACTIVE.
SUPER_ADMIN can view any admin. ADMIN can only view their own profile.
SUPER_ADMIN updates any admin's profile. Cannot self-update via this endpoint.
SUPER_ADMIN changes any admin's password without requiring old password.
SUPER_ADMIN changes any admin's email address. Must be unique.
SUPER_ADMIN deactivates an admin. Cannot self-deactivate. Sets status to DISABLED.
SUPER_ADMIN activates a disabled admin. Sets status to ACTIVE.
Get current authenticated admin's profile using JWT token.
Update current authenticated admin's profile (fullName, phoneNumber).
Change current authenticated admin's password. Requires old password verification.
Change current authenticated admin's email address.
SUPER_ADMIN can view any admin's audit. ADMIN can only view their own audit trail.
Get all users with PENDING status. SuperAdmin sees all, Admin/Organizer see only users they created.
Get all REFEREE users with PENDING status.
Get all FIGHTER users with PENDING status.
Get all uploaded document URLs for a user.
Approve a pending user and set status to ACTIVE.
Reject a pending user with a reason note.
Retrieve a list of all available countries. Public endpoint.
Create a new country. Only SUPER_ADMIN can perform this action.
Retrieve a specific country by its UUID. Public endpoint.
Retrieve a specific country by its 2-letter ISO code (e.g., 'US', 'FR', 'MA'). Public endpoint.
Delete a country by its UUID. Only SUPER_ADMIN can perform this action. Cannot delete countries that have associated clubs.
List all sports.

Delete a sport.

Delete a master category.
List age rules attached to a sport.
